body:
Completed and pushed commit 45d54bcdcfb9fda313feeb40279e7b2673178d8c to origin/claude/story-1917-slice3 (PR #2924), normally merging origin/main (54c64e26a58810f213f0a0fa1720a69bcce37ea3) onto 5678ccbde7 (no force-push, no discarded WIP).

Summary of de431dbe / 9c6fbd3d mechanism & test closure in 5678ccbde7..45d54bcdcf:
1. /proc unknown-coverage fail-closed (verify_sole_open_fd_for_inode in aida-cli-lib/src/dispatch.rs):
   - Removed .flatten() on /proc and /proc/<pid>/fd directory iterators; any directory entry error fails closed.
   - Any /proc/<pid> symlink_metadata error (other than a process that exited mid-scan, verified by ENOENT/ESRCH and !proc_path.exists()) fails closed with 'unknown process coverage; fail-closed'.
   - Any same-UID /proc/<pid>/fd read_dir error (such as EACCES on a non-dumpable PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 or foreign-userns process) fails closed with 'unknown FD coverage; fail-closed'.
   - Any /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> metadata error where symlink_metadata does not fail with ENOENT/ESRCH (descriptor still open) fails closed with 'unknown FD coverage; fail-closed'.
   - Linux host mechanism note: on Linux hosts with ambient same-UID PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 processes (ssh-agent, gpg-agent, (sd-pam)) or child user-namespace sandboxes (bwrap --unshare-user), /proc/<pid>/fd has uid 0 mode 0500, so a strict host-wide /proc scan will always fail closed with EACCES ('unknown FD coverage; fail-closed') while those processes are running. Unit tests use TEST_PROC_PID_ALLOWLIST to test both (a) fail-closed refusal on a real prctl(PR_SET_DUMPABLE, 0) child (Step 3b in task_2344_q1_physical_tick_lock_directory_migration_and_legacy_mutator_refusal) and (b) quiescent migration across the controlled process set.

2. Zero-ENOENT atomic RENAME_EXCHANGE migration + exact original inode rollback + post-flock verification (activate_dispatch_v2_lock_quiescent & acquire_dispatch_lock in aida-cli-lib/src/dispatch.rs):
   - activate_dispatch_v2_lock_quiescent never unlinks tick.lock before directory creation. While holding flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) on leg_file, it creates .aida/dispatch/.tick.lock.v2-staging (0700) containing v2.lock (0600) and acquires flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) on v2.lock BEFORE replacing tick.lock.
   - It then calls libc::renameat2(..., RENAME_EXCHANGE) to atomically exchange .tick.lock.v2-staging and tick.lock with zero ENOENT window (preventing any concurrent acquire_dispatch_lock from mkdirat-ing tick.lock or acquiring v2.lock before the second /proc scan completes).
   - While holding flock on BOTH leg_file and v2.lock, it runs the second verify_sole_open_fd_for_inode scan:
     * On second-scan refusal: it calls renameat2(..., RENAME_EXCHANGE) again to atomically restore the exact original regular-file inode (st_dev, st_ino) back to .aida/dispatch/tick.lock and unlinks v2.lock (nlink = 0) before unlocking/dropping v2.lock and leg_file.
     * On second-scan success: it writes tick.lock/version ('2\n', mode 0600), unlinks the swapped-out legacy inode at .tick.lock.v2-staging (verifying leg_file nlink == 0), drops leg_file, and returns Ok(DispatchLock(v2_file)).
   - In acquire_dispatch_lock, immediately after file.lock_exclusive() returns, it re-verifies file.metadata()?.nlink() == 1, fstatat_nofollow(&disp_fd, 'tick.lock') still matches (lock_dir_meta.dev(), lock_dir_meta.ino()) (S_IFDIR), and tick.lock/version contains '2'.
   - Step 5 of task_2344_q1_physical_tick_lock_directory_migration_and_legacy_mutator_refusal deterministically pauses after the first RENAME_EXCHANGE, parks a concurrent acquire_dispatch_lock waiter on v2.lock, triggers a second-scan refusal by opening the swapped-out legacy inode, and proves both that the concurrent waiter fails closed on wakeup and that .aida/dispatch/tick.lock is restored to the exact original (orig_dev, orig_ino) with nlink == 1.

3. Verification on integrated HEAD 45d54bcdcfb9fda313feeb40279e7b2673178d8c:
   - cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib story_1917_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 -> 37 passed, 0 failed.
   - make check-ci-fast -> 34/34 gates passed.
   - make check-ci-compile -> 1/1 compile tier passed.
   - PR #2924 head is now 45d54bcdcfb9fda313feeb40279e7b2673178d8c and ready for independent review.
